description: An insulated steel door on a heavy latch, and behind it a room of stacked crates and hanging halves under a bulb in a wire cage. The cold comes out at you as a physical shove. There is a safety release on the inside, painted over, and a chalked tally on the door that stopped being updated on a Thursday.

flags.aliases: walk-in, walkin, cold room, cold store, fridge

name: Walk-In Cold Room
